article.story: GREELEY, Colo. -- — Andrew Crawford scored 14 points as Northern Colorado beat Northern New Mexico 102-52 on Tuesday. Crawford added 13 rebounds for the Bears (2-1). Langston Reynolds scored 13 points and added five rebounds and seven assists. Steven Ramirez Jr. had 11 points and shot 4-for-6, including 3-for-5 from beyond the arc. Marquise Delahaye led the Eagles in scoring, finishing with 16 points, seven rebounds and two steals. Northern New Mexico also got 12 points from Jordan Morency. Up next Northern Colorado’s next game is Saturday against South Dakota State. Northern New Mexico visits New Mexico on Tuesday. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
